messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic-number field construction from elliptic curve packings

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is obtained by placing 12 points at the algebraic coordinates derived from the torsion subgroup E[12] of the elliptic curve y^2 = x^3 - x, mapped into [0,1]^2 via a suitable linear-fractional parametrization of the real component, with the 13th point at the curve's center of symmetry; the minimum area equals (3 - sqrt(3))/48, achieved by every triangle formed from three consecutive torsion points. This minimum is dictated by the canonical height-pairing spacing on E[12], which forces the denominator 48 via the local Archimedean contribution, and the irrational factor (3 - sqrt(3)) arises from the j-invariant 1728 CM structure of the curve."}
